# pcd_networking_qos_dscp_marking_rule (Resource)

Manages a DSCP-marking rule on a Neutron QoS policy in PCD.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pcd_networking_qos_policy" "example" {
  name = "tf-example-qos"
}

resource "pcd_networking_qos_dscp_marking_rule" "example" {
  qos_policy_id = pcd_networking_qos_policy.example.id
  dscp_mark     = 26
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dscp_mark` (Number) The DSCP mark value (0, 8-56 in valid increments).
- `qos_policy_id` (String) The QoS policy this rule belongs to. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `region` (String) The region. Defaults to the provider's region.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The rule ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import pcd_networking_qos_dscp_marking_rule.example <qos_policy_id>/<rule_id>
```
